{{Top}}
A '''xenobiologist''', or '''xenologist''', was a specialist in the universe's life forms, such as animals, plants, fungi and bacteria. They worked in ecological projects for the maintenance of several [[Planet/Legends|planets]]' biodiversity and in some medical units, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref><ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

The natural interest that [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] showed towards the protection of every kind of life form made them natural xenobiologists, with many of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most important xenobiologists being of this species.<ref name="The Ruins of Dantooine">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref>
